reviews.comment:
El servicio de despecho de NAFTA muy bien, la atención dentro del mercado pésima.
La señora q atendía, muy prepotente y con muy mala onda, compré unas cosas y me deje unos chicles en el mostrador. Salí al auto me di cuenta, entre y me dijo. No había dejado nada q seguro los había tirado afuera (cosa q no porque fueron 2 metros de distancia.

(Translated by Google)
The NAFTA service counter was very good, but the service inside the market was terrible.

The woman who was working there was very arrogant and had a really bad attitude. I bought some things and left some chewing gum on the counter. I went out to my car and realized, then went back inside and she told me I hadn't left anything, that I must have thrown it outside (which wasn't true because it was about two meters away).
